publisher: data.police.uk / UK police open data service
identifier_semantics: The API documentation defines id as the unique force identifier used for force-specific API requests.
coverage_caveat: The force-list method excludes British Transport Police. The site covers open crime/policing data for England, Wales and Northern Ireland.
local_join_instruction: Do not treat these identifiers as canonical parcels. Local OpenCode must perform any parcel/coverage association.
